title: Outlaw Paintball

services.name: Outlaw Paintball
services.desc: Paintball is one of the most thrilling ways to spend a day outdoors, but safety should always come first. The excitement of the game often leads players to forget that paintball markers shoot at high speeds, which can cause injury if not handled properly. The most important piece of gear is a certified paintball mask. Never remove it while on the field, even for a moment. Eye and face protection is non-negotiable. Next up: wear long sleeves, gloves, and padded clothing to minimize the sting of paintballs. blurb: Outlaw Paintball offers paintball adventures with a variety of fields to roam. They provide private parties with exclusive group access and after-hours play for intense, adrenaline-filled paintball experiences. The facility emphasizes fun, teamwork, and safety on the paintball field.
